title: DevSecOps and cloud security engineer with a software engineering foundation.
paragraphs: I build security into the software delivery path: source control, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, application architecture, and operational visibility. My background is full-stack and platform engineering, which helps me understand how engineering teams actually ship software and where security controls need to fit.

My strongest proof point is SecureObs, a production-deployed security SaaS I solo-designed and built. It brings together open-source scanners, cross-tool deduplication, CI/CD build gates, tenant isolation, and credential-free Terraform attack-path analysis into one platform.

I am targeting DevSecOps, cloud security, application security, and security engineering roles where I can combine hands-on development with secure-by-design architecture, automation, least-privilege access, and pragmatic risk reduction.
